title: Market-intelligence lenses
tagline: Turning a graph of NYC AI rooms into four readable lenses (attended, research, market, job), fed by scheduled lanes and read every Monday.
why: Topic trends had quietly stopped absorbing new topics after 8 August. 102 of 272 topics had no theme, and 9 of the 25 events attended since 6 August added nothing to any trend. The health view's tripwire had been firing, but nothing alerted on it.
mission: A knowledge graph read through four lenses, sliceable by theme, segment, cohort and time. Each lens is fed by a lane, and every lane has a schedule, a run ledger, an alarm, a named consumer and a kill rule.
destination: Every lane writes on schedule and alarms when it goes quiet. A Monday Market Brief reads the lenses, so prep for any room starts from what moved that week, not from a blank page.
showcase: Diagnosing a silent data failure from the live database, and stating the do-nothing baseline before claiming a fix
Dimensional modelling for analytics: a slice contract with effective-dated theme membership, so a merge never breaks trend comparability
One guarded client for every pipeline write, with each schema change rehearsed on a twin database before it reaches production
Operating discipline for pipelines: each lane ships with a ledger, an alarm, a consumer and a kill rule, or it doesn't ship

decisions.decision: Replace the fixed 30-theme taxonomy with topics and subtopics that can group and evolve.
decisions.why: A fixed list kept dropping new subjects on the floor.

decisions.decision: Assign a topic to a theme at the moment it's created, in the session that has full context. The nightly job becomes a backstop.
decisions.why: The best embedding-only assigner reached 0.90 precision on just 5.9% of topics (PR #266).

decisions.decision: Build four lenses with sliceable cohorts instead of one trend view.
decisions.why: Thin data is a reason to ingest more, not to shrink the scope.

open.question: Which source replaces the company-signals trial when it lapses at the end of November?

risks.risk: The nightly health check is red while lane 1 stays in dry-run, and a red check can hide a real failure.
risks.mitigation: Take lane 1 writes live after its first Sunday run is checked.
